rules.trigger: A signed fixed-point conversion requires round-to-nearest-even and saturation
rules.action: Use a consistently signed floor quotient plus a nonnegative fractional remainder; at an exact half increment only an odd quotient; retain enough width for the increment and saturate after rounding
rules.check: Test positive and negative half ties, neighboring remainders and both saturation boundaries; verify the rounding predicate contributes numeric zero or positive one at the addition width
rules.caveat: Do not use unconditional half-unit bias as a ties-to-even substitute; replicating an asserted bit across the width is not a positive-one increment

rules.trigger: An arithmetic right shift consumes a signed value
rules.action: Make signedness explicit before the arithmetic shift and keep the shift operand signed
rules.check: Test negative, zero and positive values at the relevant shift amount
rules.caveat: A cast changes signedness, not width; port declarations remain unchanged
